rationale.edition: The change spans both OSS and enterprise paths. Enterprise-owned paths (o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/ai/client/mod.rs, o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/alerts/rca_service.rs, o2_enterprise/Cargo.toml) hold the AI agent client and RCA service, while OSS paths (web/src/components/O2AIChat.vue, src/api/management/src/request/ai/chat.rs, src/infra/**) hold the shared frontend and backend routing/session plumbing. Because the combined diff touches both the enterprise layer and the OSS layer, edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no explicit opt-out: feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, so no 'tests-added' label or skip comment was supplied. The change is user-facing (it alters the O2AI chat panel behavior), so it does not qualify as docs-only or CI-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. web/src/components/O2AIChat.vue is the O2AI chat assistant UI, and the diff adds a user-visible restore flow: when a session's owning replica is gone the stream surfaces a session_owner_unavailable error, the conversation is restored, and a RESTORED_NOTICE is shown to the user. It also surfaces inline error blocks when a tool confirmation cannot be delivered. These are user-exercisable UI behaviors worth verifying.
rationale.area: GeneralTests — the O2AI chat assistant is a cross-cutting panel (not specific to Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards/Alerts), and the existing GeneralTests shard already hosts other assistant/general UI specs (model-pricing.spec.js, theme-management.spec.js). The changed component lives at web/src/components/O2AIChat.vue, a general component rather than a product-area-specific plugin.
rationale.group: GeneralTests — the closest existing playwright.yml matrix shard (tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json) whose run_files list contains general, non-area-specific UI specs; the AI chat panel fits there rather than any Logs-/Dashboards-/Traces-* shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/components/O2AIChat.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test (not under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**), so it does not count as E2E coverage and does not set existing_tests_in_diff. No Playwright .spec.js files were added or modified.
